name: Pet Carrier
description: Guidelines for traveling with pet carrier in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Soft-sided pet carriers are allowed in the cabin if they meet airline size limits to fit under the seat ahead. Pets require fees/booking.

checkedBag.reason: Hard-sided pet crates are allowed in checked baggage/cargo holds under strict airline regulations.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring pet carrier on a plane?

travelTips: Soft-sided pet carriers are allowed in the cabin if they meet airline size limits to fit under the seat ahead. Pets require fees/booking.

faq.question: Is pet carrier allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Pet Carrier is allowed in carry-on luggage. Soft-sided pet carriers are allowed in the cabin if they meet airline size limits to fit under the seat ahead. Pets require fees/booking.

faq.question: Can you pack pet carrier in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Pet Carrier is allowed in checked bags. Hard-sided pet crates are allowed in checked baggage/cargo holds under strict airline regulations.
